name: Electricité et Eaux de Madagascar S.A.
summary: Electricité et Eaux de Madagascar Société Anonyme (EEM.PA) is primarily engaged in the luxury hospitality sector in Cambodia. The firm's portfolio also encompasses interests in real estate, paper manufacturing, and casino operations. Originally known as Viktoria Invest SA, the company rebranded to its current name in January 2019. Established in 1928, its corporate headquarters are located in Paris, France.
